pkgmetadata.longdescription: Obscura is a two-party VPN: the operator of the entry relay never sees traffic content, and the independent exit hop never sees who sent it. The tunnel is WireGuard carried over QUIC, with an nftables kill switch. This package installs upstream's prebuilt Debian binaries: the obscura CLI and its root service (the daemon behind "obscura service"), and, with USE=gui, the GTK4/WebKit desktop app. An OpenRC init script is always installed; the systemd unit is optional.

use.flag: Install the obscura-gui desktop application (GTK4, libadwaita and net-libs/webkit-gtk:6)
